basics.name: Saurabh Upadhyay
basics.label: Flutter Developer
basics.summary: Flutter developer in Mumbai, working professionally with Flutter since 2023. Builds, releases and supports his own Android apps and developer tools: Guidester on pub.dev, and Snapdrop, Sanatan Guide and Sahaj on Google Play. Open to mobile roles in broking, mutual funds and fintech; Flutter first, React Native too. Employment history on request.

projects.name: Guidester
projects.description: In-app tester feedback for Flutter: testers tap the spot that's wrong and type; the comment reaches a dashboard with a screenshot, the screen name and device context. Flutter package, Flutter web dashboard, self-hosted Supabase backend. MIT.
highlights: Published on pub.dev under the verified publisher saurabhupadhyay.in
Live browser demos of the tester flow and the dashboard

projects.name: Snapdrop: Phone to Figma
projects.description: Android app and Figma plugin: scan the plugin's QR code and send up to ten photos from the phone straight into Figma.

projects.name: Sanatan Guide
projects.description: Offline Android reader for the Bhagavad Gita, the Vedas and the Upanishads: 32 texts, 133,613 verses, built from public-domain sources with a Python parsing pipeline.

projects.name: Sahaj
projects.description: Guided men's wellness training app for Android, with in-app purchases.

projects.name: Mutual Fund Explorer
projects.description: Search Indian mutual funds, read NAV history, keep a watchlist and record holdings with exact returns (XIRR), using the free mfapi.in data.
